act_1.label: Frustration (짜증)
act_1.goal: Identify a specific, visceral pain point. 'What the hell is this?'
act_1.trigger: A real-world breaking point (Monday morning crash, 3 hours wasted).

act_2.label: The Mess (난리)
act_2.goal: Show the struggle of implementation. 'I built it, and it broke again.'
act_2.trigger: Unexpected errors, cascading failures, or the realization that the solution is the problem.

act_3.label: The Deep Dive (파헤침)
act_3.goal: Translate technical complexity into everyday metaphors. 'RAG is like my mom's closet.'
act_3.trigger: Insight through failure. A punchy declaration or a 'still breaking' reality.

voice_constraints.mandatory_rhythm: One sentence per line. 3-7 word punches. Self-correction patterns.
voice_constraints.nike_rule: Action > Dialogue. Products are background. People/Experience are foreground.
